name: Infiltration Load Plausibility
trigger_conditions: envelope insulation age or condition unresolved
anti_triggers: infiltration already bounded by air-balance evidence
physical_basis: Infiltration through doors, dock seals and envelope leaks adds latent and sensible load that the refrigeration plant must continuously offset. Latent load drives defrost frequency.
operational_basis: Door discipline, air-curtain operation and dock-seal condition typically deteriorate without visible signal. The plant compensates silently until it cannot.
financial_mechanism: Infiltration load is misattributed to refrigeration inefficiency, leading to wrong CAPEX (compressor) instead of envelope/door discipline.
typical_false_assumption: Refrigeration kWh rise means the compressor is the problem.
hypothesis: Infiltration load may be a major share of refrigeration duty and should be falsified before compressor-first logic.
rival_hypotheses: envelope is tight and infiltration is immaterial
falsification_conditions: envelope tightness bounded by recent commissioning
allowed_claim_language: Infiltration load is a plausible loss-pattern that must be falsified before refrigeration-CAPEX logic.
claim_permissions_impact: block compressor-CAPEX-first logic until envelope is falsified
example_outputs: Before funding compressor work, falsify dock-seal and door-traffic infiltration.
tests: cold_chain bundle should activate this when door/seal evidence is missing
__ai_scaffolding__: S4 in AI_SCAFFOLDING_REGISTRY.md — handwritten by Claude in V2 Gap E. Replace with extraction from IIAR Bulletins / ASHRAE Handbook Refrigeration / Danfoss handbooks via V4 Industrial Research Engine.
